title.zh: Manus撤销Meta收购后再融超5亿美元，估值翻倍
title.en: Manus撤销Meta收购后再融超5亿美元，估值翻倍

current_state.zh: Manus parent Butterfly Effect raised over $500M at roughly double the ~$2B valuation from its forced Meta acquisition unwind, with Boyu Capital and IDG Capital leading and Tencent, Sequoia China and ZhenFund re-investing, while weighing a restructuring for a future Hong Kong IPO.
